posts.author: areksan
posts.body: I need help to know if there is a way to archive this frame effect like the image, by a plugin, image technique or by editing the Window.png

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
I assume you meant to ask "achieve," not "archive."
You would need to get a plugin written to change which portions of the windowskin file are used for the corners and edges of the window - or to grab from a different file entirely for the corners, I don't think those could even fit in the windowskin.
You could possibly use existing plugins that let you use a picture for the background of certain windows. Make the windowskin itself have transparent corners and make a picture with those fancy bits to use for the background.
